recognize_zh: 視野中以早幼粒、骨髓球、後骨髓球等各階段顆粒球為主，並可見環狀核（ring nucleus）及分葉異常、顆粒偏少的嗜中性球，嗜酸與嗜鹼性球不多，符合 aCML 的顆粒球發育不良。
features: Marked granulocytic predominance with left-shifted maturation (promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Dysgranulopoiesis: ring-shaped nucleus and abnormally segmented neutrophil nuclei
Hypogranular to unevenly granulated cytoplasm in maturing neutrophils
Blasts not increased in this field
No conspicuous basophilia or eosinophilia; scattered erythroid precursors
describe_en: Aspirate smear (likely bone marrow) shows a markedly granulocytic cell population with all stages of maturation, predominantly promyelocytes, myelocytes and metamyelocytes. Dysgranulopoietic features are evident, including a neutrophil with a ring-shaped nucleus, abnormal nuclear segmentation, and hypogranular cytoplasm in several maturing cells. Blasts are not increased in this field, and basophils and monocytes are not prominent. In the setting of BCR-ABL1-negative neutrophilic leukocytosis with circulating immature granulocytes, findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: CML shows prominent basophilia and eosinophilia with little dysgranulopoiesis and requires BCR-ABL1 demonstration.
CNL shows mature segmented neutrophils with toxic granulation, <10% immature granulocytes, no significant dysplasia, and CSF3R mutation.
CMML requires persistent monocytosis (≥1×10⁹/L and ≥10% monocytes), whereas monocytes are not prominent here.
Reactive granulocytosis shows toxic granulation and Döhle bodies without ring nuclei, hypogranularity or clonal abnormalities.
